metadata.timing_method: Monotonic parent-process wall clock; RPC response includes rebuild/preview geometry, tessellation and JSON serialization. Startup includes process creation and doc.open; operating-system file caches are uncontrolled.
metadata.memory_method: /usr/bin/time -l maximum core resident set size over each complete core process, including RPC scenes, preview states and undo checkpoints; no polling estimate.
